title: High quality containers
text: High quality containers. This is the fourth purchase of Bentago products I have purchased.  All of them are the best quality and portions on the market.  I won't buy from anyone else.

product_metadata.title: Bentgo Prep 2-Compartment Meal-Prep Containers with Custom-Fit Lids - Microwaveable, Durable, Reusable, BPA-Free, Freezer and Dishwasher Safe Food Storage Containers - 10 Trays & 10 Lids (Blush Pink)
features: MEAL-PREP MADE EASY: Trays and lids nest together, stack neatly, and are microwaveable to make meal-prep a breeze
PORTION-PERFECT: No need to measure your portions — volume is already embossed on the tray
SEALS IN FRESHNESS: Custom-fit lids keep meals fresh during refrigeration, freezing, and when taking meals on-the-go

PURCHASE WITH A PURPOSE: Bentgo continues to be a proud supporter of Feed the Children, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that gives hope and resources for hungry children and families. Since 2017, Bentgo has donated more than $300,000 to help put an end to hunger.
WHAT YOU GET: 10 two-compartment trays, 10 custom-fit lids, meal prep eBook, and caring customer support
